Author: Anand Pathak
Bench: Anand Pathak
 1
 In The High Court Of Madhya Pradesh
 At Gwalior
 Before
 Hon'Ble Shri Justice Anand Pathak
 On The 8 th Of January, 2024
 Misc. Criminal Case No. 38225 of 2023
 Between:-
 1. B Dinkar S/O Shri Neeraja Brung, Aged

 (Madhya Pradesh)

 This application coming on for admission this day, t  following:
 ORDER Instant petition has been filed under Section 482 of Cr.P.C. At the outset, learned counsel for the petitioners informed this Court that purpose of filing of this petition is over because acquittal has been recorded in favour of the petitioners. Therefore, this petition has become infructuous. 
Accordingly, the present petition stands dismissed as rendered infructuous.
